changes.title: Jaw tones stag
items: Lions, bears and stags keep their coat colour on their lower jaw, and open mouths show just their fangs (a stag two small front teeth) instead of a pale block of teeth
The stag legend's flaming antlers sweep back instead of towering three times its height

changes.title: Stegosaurus
items: A new animal for a later island: the stegosaurus of the Cinder slopes, black basalt glowing with lava in its cracks, cycads, tree ferns and stunted pines
Its plates stand bold and orange along its back and its tail ends in four great spikes; asleep, its plates rise out of the ash like a ridge of old stones
Its island shows black and volcanic on the sea chart, its lakes lava

changes.title: Coloured shadows
items: Every shadow takes its colour from the light it lies in: blue-violet by a campfire, a warm shade in the moonlight (under the creatures and the witch, and the trees' and scenery's)
Anything standing in a tree's or a ruin's shadow is darkened by it too, not just the ground: creatures, the witch, bushes and props
One "Shadow colour" slider on the pause page for them all
